title: More Than Food: The Many Uses of Corn
seo_title: More Than Food: The Many Uses of Corn in Springfield
description: More Than Food: The Many Uses of Corn is an outdoors program at Rutledge-Wilson Farm Park that looks at the different ways corn is used. It is for students in grades 6-12. It takes place on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 9:00 AM at 3825 W Farm Road 146 in Springfield, MO.
